messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> inference-gateway-high-5xx-rate (P1). Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% in us-west-2 for 3m. pd_incident: INC1234567
matt: acked
matt: I’m looking now. @eng-sre can you pause any deploys to gateway in us-west-2? :mag:
pd-bot: matt acknowledged the page
nina: added context: we rolled traffic weight to a canary cluster ~10m ago
matt: seeing backend 502/504 spike in gateway logs, kvcache eviction errors around same time
ria: can we shift traffic to eu-west-1 temporarily? Any global failover play? @sre-oncall
matt: initiating route-swap to eu-west-1 + lowering concurrency on gateway pods. Running command:
```
kubectl scale deployment gateway-usw2 --replicas=0 --namespace=prod
```
matt: also setting throttling header to 100 rps in ingress
ops-bot: route-swap started (job-id: rs-9872). Estimated duration 30s
nina: customer impact: ~4% of requests 5xx are user-facing (in-flight chats). CS pinged
matt: traffic shifted 70% to eu-west-1, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% in 90s
ria: warming kvcache on eu-west helped, leaving canary offline for now
matt: creating short incident note, will hand off to nina for night watch
matt: handing to @nina - please monitor for next 2h and escalate if >2% again
nina: ack handoff, will watch dashboards and coordinate with infra if it recurs :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: matt assigned, nina on rotation handoff
matt: incident closed (mitigated) — followup: look into eviction thresholds and canary rollout gating; cc @eng-ml
nina: filing follow-up ticket: INF-4532 - canary rollout weight + kvcache eviction tuning
matt: thanks all :heart:
